title: Warhammer's Vampire Survivors-Like Brings Insane Pixel Action to PS5 in November
text: Warhammer's Vampire Survivors-Like Brings Insane Pixel Action to PS5 in November | Push Square Menu Search Share Guest Guest Login | Sign Up Push Square News Reviews Features Videos Games PS Plus Guides Forums Search Keywords Guest Login or Sign Up Home Choose Topics... Manage Topics News Auroch Digital PS5 Warhammer Release Dates Trailers Warhammer's Vampire Survivors-Like Brings Insane Pixel Action to PS5 in November Hammer blow by Robert Ramsey 7 hours ago Share: Warhammer Survivors , the Warhammer game that's quite clearly taken inspiration from Vampire Survivors , now has a confirmed release date on PS5. Unfazed by the looming shadow of GTA 6 , the chaotic roguelite title launches on the 10th November, priced at £6.39 / $7.99 / €7.49. There'll also be a 10% discount on release, and if you pre-order, but only on "select" platforms. We don't yet know if that includes Sony's current-gen console. It sounds like Bristol-based developer Auroch Digital's stuffed as much content into Warhammer Survivors as it can. The game features over 40 playable characters from throughout Warhammer 40,000 and Age of Sigmar lore, and you can wield over 75 types of weapons. Subscribe to Push Square on YouTube 172k Are you up for crushing waves upon waves upon waves of humanity's enemies? Never stop blasting in the comments section below. I'd gone months without gaming, I'd been talking to people about games (the ones they were playing) and I felt the hobby slip away until a couple of people suggested I try Vampyre Survivors. It was like finding gaming again, I spent hours that night feeling something I hadn't in so long. The negativity of the industry was strangling my interest in gaming, I couldn't find anything to counteract all of the noise and that one game served as a template, one I still use today. The game and the DLCs were so cheap that it felt like I was robbing the Developers, after buying so many survivor/likes I can finally support that Studio again and I couldn't be happier. Everything I knew about Warhammer (at first) came from Plus+ and games like Inquisitor, Chaos Bane then I started trying the audiobooks/horror novels (they have some) buying the Codex books for the art and I can see why people are so into the IP, I hope this game sells gangbusters for them, they deserve it. 1 11 Krlozgod 4 hours ago @GirlVersusGame Vampire Survivors is a master piece in my opinion.
